evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we propose MicroEdit, a neuron-level editing method that performs minimal and controlled interventions within LLMs.
By leveraging a sparse autoencoder (SAE), MicroEdit disentangles knowledge representations and activates only a minimal set of necessary neurons for precise parameter updates.
Extensive experiments show that MicroEdit outperforms prior methods and robustly handles lifelong knowledge editing across QA and Hallucination settings on LLaM and Mistral.
